official: 立川市後期高齢者医療条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会議案一覧

name: 後期高齢者医療の公示方法を変更
summary: 後期高齢者医療に関する公示送達は、現在、市の掲示場への掲示で行います。この議案では、公示内容を不特定多数が閲覧できる状態にしたうえで、市の掲示場への掲示か、市の事務所にある電子計算機の画面で閲覧できるようにする方法に変えます。
changes: 公示事項を不特定多数が閲覧できる状態にし、掲示場への掲示または市の事務所の電子計算機画面で閲覧できるようにする
who: 後期高齢者医療に関する公示送達の対象となる人
why: 地方税法等の一部を改正する法律が公布されたためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Changes how notices are served for medical care for people aged 75 and over
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Tachikawa City Ordinance on Medical Care for Older Senior Citizens
en.summary: Service by public notice concerning medical care for people aged 75 and over is currently carried out by posting on the city's notice board. This bill changes the method so that the notice details are made available for the public to view, and can then be viewed either on the city's notice board or on a computer screen at a city office.
changes: Make the notice details available for the public to view, and allow them to be viewed either on the city's notice board or on a computer screen at a city office
who: People subject to service by public notice concerning medical care for people aged 75 and over
en.why: The city says this is because the Act Partially Amending the Local Tax Act, etc. was promulgated.
